The '''Rocantor sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Star system/Legends|Systems]] in the sector included the [[Ord Vaug system/Legends|Ord Vaug system]], [[Rocantor system/Legends|Rocantor system]], [[Serria system/Legends|Serria system]] and the
[[Yabosta system/Legends|Yabosta system]].<ref name="EAOC" />
